component.name: Omriss
component.summary: A text editor that helps clarify ideas and refine them, layer by layer

description.p: Omriss edits Markdown and JSON as layers: the Document Map shows the structure of a file, and each section or value opens on its own, so you work on one idea at a time and see where it sits in the whole.
Omriss keeps your file as you wrote it: an edit changes the text you edited, and the rest of the file, including its line endings and formatting, stays as it was.

screenshot.caption: Editing a section, with the Document Map on the left
